name: Gate
description: The 2 × 2 Gate in the wall. Two pictures: passage along x (walls east and west) and along y (walls north and south).

variants.name: Tripo gatehouse (walls north–south)
variants.notes: Owner 20 Nov 2026: 3D model generated by the owner in Tripo (stone_tower_3d_model.glb), rendered by Blender in the game projection and sun, stretched 12 % across so it fills its 2 × 2 tiles. Door on the right face: the passage runs east–west, walls join north and south. v2 (owner 21 Nov 2026, "věž a bránu klidně vyrenderuj znovu pokud to bude lepší"): the foot of the model stretched to cover its 2 × 2 tiles exactly, so walls meet it with no gap.
